homestead.skycraft.name: %s's Homestead
message.skycraft.homestead.plot_taken: Someone already holds the deed to this land.
homestead.skycraft.deposit.tool.stone: You need a pickaxe to quarry stone here.
homestead.skycraft.deposit.tool.clay: You need a shovel or a pickaxe to dig clay here.
homestead.skycraft.deposit.tired: You are too tired to work.
homestead.skycraft.plot.buy_first: Buy the deed to this land first.
homestead.skycraft.build.too_big: That would reach past your homestead's boundary.
homestead.skycraft.build.not_loaded: Stand closer to the building site.
homestead.skycraft.build.blocked.require: Something else has to be built first.
homestead.skycraft.build.blocked.slot: That wing already has a room.
homestead.skycraft.steward.no_house: Build the small house first: a steward needs somewhere to live.
homestead.skycraft.steward.title: %s, Steward
homestead.skycraft.screen.claim: Homestead of %s (%s blocks around the table)
homestead.skycraft.screen.no_steward: Hire a steward to buy building materials and livestock.
homestead.skycraft.screen.free_claim: A homestead of your own choosing: no deed needed.
homestead.skycraft.screen.bounds: Plot: %s blocks around the drafting table, foundations up to %s deep, roofs up to %s high.
homestead.skycraft.material.nails.desc: Twenty nails from an iron ingot. Every plan needs them.
homestead.skycraft.material.hinge.desc: Two door hinges from an iron ingot.
homestead.skycraft.material.lock.desc: A lock for a door or chest, from an iron ingot.
homestead.skycraft.material.iron_fitting: Brackets and straps for beams and furniture, from an iron ingot.
homestead.skycraft.material.sawn_log.des: Three logs squared into one sawn log. A steward sells them cheaper by the ten.
homestead.skycraft.material.quarried_sto: Four cobblestones dressed into quarried stone. A bought plot has its own stone deposit.
homestead.skycraft.material.glass_pane.d: Windows: sixteen panes from six glass.
homestead.skycraft.plan.small_house.desc: A one-room house with a bed, a hearth and a cooking pot. It becomes the entryway of the main hall.
homestead.skycraft.plan.main_hall.desc: The great hall: a central fire pit, long tables, chests and shelves. Wings and a cellar can be added to it.
homestead.skycraft.plan.bedrooms.desc: West wing: a double bed for you and your spouse, and beds for two children.
homestead.skycraft.plan.greenhouse.desc: West wing: a glass house with watered planting beds for crops and herbs.
homestead.skycraft.plan.enchanters_tower: West wing: a three-floor tower with an arcane enchanter and shelves of books.
homestead.skycraft.plan.storage_room.des: North wing: chests and barrels for everything you carry home.
homestead.skycraft.plan.trophy_room.desc: North wing: pedestals and mannequins for the spoils of your hunts.
homestead.skycraft.plan.alchemy_laborato: North wing: an alchemy lab, a brewing stand and a little herb garden.
homestead.skycraft.plan.kitchen.desc: East wing: a cooking hearth, an oven and a smoker, and room to store food.
homestead.skycraft.plan.library.desc: East wing: walls of bookshelves, a lectern and a reading desk.
homestead.skycraft.plan.armory.desc: East wing: a grindstone, an armor workbench, an anvil and mannequins.
homestead.skycraft.plan.cellar.desc: A stone cellar under the main hall with a shrine of Mara, an alchemy lab and an enchanter.
homestead.skycraft.plan.garden.desc: A fenced vegetable garden with a water channel, beside the house.
homestead.skycraft.plan.animal_pen.desc: A fenced pen with hay and a water trough; it comes with a cow and two chickens.
homestead.skycraft.plan.workshop.desc: Smelter, forge, anvil, grindstone and tanning rack under a lean-to roof.
message.skycraft.homestead.table_in_use: A house stands on these plans. Sneak to dismantle the drafting table and give up the homestead.
message.skycraft.homestead.near_place: Too close to %s: a homestead needs open land of its own.
message.skycraft.homestead.bad_ground: No homestead can stand on this ground.
message.skycraft.homestead.build_mode.on: Build mode on: take up stations and chests with a left click and set them down again. It ends when you leave the homestead.
message.skycraft.homestead.build_mode.ou: Stand inside your homestead to enter build mode.
message.skycraft.homestead.needs_build_m: Enter build mode at the drafting table to carry this.
homestead.skycraft.perm.hint: Only you build and break in your homestead, whatever perks others have. These levels say who may use things. In build mode, sneak and use a door, chest, station or bed to give that one its own level.
homestead.skycraft.home.name: Homestead name
homestead.skycraft.home.name_info: Shown on your map, the compass and to anyone who discovers it. Leave empty for the default.
homestead.skycraft.home.build_mode.info: Pick up and move stations, chests and lecterns without losing what is inside. Sneak and use the table to switch it too.
homestead.skycraft.home.grounds: The grounds: %s blocks around the table
homestead.skycraft.home.map_info: Your homestead is on your map and fast-travel list. Others see only a point on the compass until they come near; then they discover it by the name you gave it.
homestead.skycraft.expand.max: The grounds are as wide as they can be.
dialogue.skycraft.homestead.found: I want land of my own. (A drafting table: %s gold)
dialogue.skycraft.homestead.land: Where is there open land to build on?
dialogue.skycraft.homestead.have_claim: You already hold a homestead; one is all the law allows.
dialogue.skycraft.homestead.have_table: You are carrying a drafting table already. Set it down on open land.
dialogue.skycraft.homestead.no_gold: That costs %s gold, and you do not have it.
dialogue.skycraft.homestead.sold_table: Take it out beyond the walls, away from roads and old stones, and set it down. That is your claim.
dialogue.skycraft.homestead.no_land: Nothing I know of near here that is not already someone's.
dialogue.skycraft.homestead.land_shown: There are %s plots out there that nobody holds: %s. I have marked them for you.
dialogue.skycraft.homestead.about: %s: grounds of %s blocks, %s buildings. Keep the drafting table safe.
dialogue.skycraft.homestead.sold: %s. Good timber is the whole of a house.
homestead.skycraft.builder.title: %s, Builder
